caption: Psalm 2 blesses those who take refuge in God; John says belief in Jesus brings life. The trust theme fits, but John never identifies this verse as a prediction.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 2 predict life through Jesus? Psalm 2 blesses those who take refuge in God or His king. John says belief in Jesus brings life.
